statsTitle: What is mapped in São Paulo
statsIntro: How many of each kind of place the map currently holds in São Paulo. These are mapped locations, not an estimate of every one that exists — coverage comes from OpenStreetMap and grows as people add to it.
ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in São Paulo on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in São Paulo
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In São Paulo it currently holds 203 public toilets and 114 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: 365 of the 6,666 places mapped in São Paulo are recorded as free of charge.
